title: Pet Groomer Email List: 59,322 US Contacts in 2026 | Scrap.io

facts.fact: SchedulingKit reports that the US pet grooming industry hit $14.5 billion in 2026.
facts.quote: The US pet grooming industry hit **$14.5 billion in 2026** ([SchedulingKit]

facts.fact: IBISWorld counts roughly 193,000 businesses in the US pet grooming and boarding space (third-party figure cited by the page).
According to SchedulingKit, pet owners spend an average of $510 per year on grooming, and 42% increase that spend year over year.
facts.quote: Pet owners are spending an average of **$510 per year on grooming**, with 42% increasing that spend year over year

facts.fact: According to SchedulingKit, mobile grooming is seeing 12-15% annual growth.
facts.quote: Mobile grooming alone is seeing **12-15% annual growth**

facts.fact: Scrap.io's own database contains 59,322 US pet groomers, including emails, phones, websites, and social profiles.
facts.quote: 59,322 US pet groomers. With emails, phones, websites, social profiles

facts.fact: Scrap.io states that its search for US pet groomers with contact data completes in about two minutes (vendor claim).
Scrap.io automatically classifies each email as individual (with first and last name extracted), contact, sales, marketing, or admin.
facts.quote: individual (with first and last name extracted), contact, sales, marketing, or admin

facts.fact: In an illustrative example on the page, a buyer paid $800 for a list of 5,000 pet groomer contacts from a traditional list broker and saw a 34% bounce rate on the first campaign.
facts.quote: Jake bought a "premium" **professional pet groomer email list** of 5,000 contacts for $800.
